import hashlib, json, pathlib, subprocess, tempfile
root = pathlib.Path.cwd()
plugin = pathlib.Path('/home/sergio/.codex/plugins/cache/fr-opus55-581dd0e1-20261011/kk/0.23.0')
bundle = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='kk-save-review-'))
base = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True).strip()
paths = ['service.py', 'client.py', 'store.py', 'tests/test_save.py', 'README.md']
manifest = {'repository': str(root), 'selector': 'git diff --cached', 'base': base, 'instructions': [], 'candidate': [], 'historical': []}
common = ['functional-review.md', 'shared-change-context.md', 'shared-review-scope-protocol.md', 'shared-capy-knowledge-protocol.md']
checks = ['security-checklist.md', 'solid-checklist.md', 'code-quality-checklist.md', 'removal-plan.md']
manifest['instructions'] = [str(plugin / 'skills/review-code' / p) for p in common] + [str(plugin / 'profiles/python/review-code' / p) for p in checks]
assert len(set(manifest['instructions'])) == 8
for instruction in manifest['instructions']:
    assert pathlib.Path(instruction).is_file()
for path in paths:
    data = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', ':' + path])
    dest = bundle / 'candidate' / path
    dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    dest.write_bytes(data)
    manifest['candidate'].append({'path': str(dest), 'original_path': path, 'revision': 'index', 'blob': subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', ':' + path], text=True).strip(), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(), 'line_span': [1, len(data.splitlines())], 'omitted_or_redacted': 'none'})
data = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', base + ':service.py'])
dest = bundle / 'historical/service.py'
dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
dest.write_bytes(data)
manifest['historical'].append({'path': str(dest), 'original_path': 'service.py', 'revision': base, 'blob': subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', base + ':service.py'], text=True).strip(), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(), 'line_span': [1, len(data.splitlines())], 'omitted_or_redacted': 'none'})
diff_path = bundle / 'staged.patch'
diff_path.write_bytes(subprocess.check_output(['git', 'diff', '--cached', '--', 'service.py']))
manifest['diff'] = str(diff_path)
context = '''Intent and authority: README.md is the explicit contract. Saving is serialized and identified by caller operation ID. A failed save may be retried with the same ID and edited values; success means latest submitted values active. Repeating a completed ID returns its receipt. A fresh ID must perform a fresh save for the same workspace. Recovery records persist for audit.
Boundary: User requested isolated review of staged save recovery update. One changed file service.py, 8 insertions/8 deletions. Worktree equals index. No implementation conversation, author rationale, or author test claims supplied.
Task Scope: No task scope available — review the diff on its own merits without assuming any feature-level design doc.
Review base: ''' + base + '''. Candidate: index service.py blob 0435141ceb7f934d59e6628b3720dea7f25f747f. Separate release/deployed baseline not named; no release assessment requested.
Contracts/consumers: client.submit delegates to service.save. Store.apply idempotently replaces preferences. Store.receipt can fail after apply and marks completed on success. README excludes threads, process restart, network service and exactly-once external effect promises.
Evidence: Complete candidate service/client/store/tests/README plus actual base service blob and full selected diff. Existing tests have not yet been executed by parent at dispatch. Other candidate files are unchanged from base.
Guidance: python activated by service.py extension; all four Python checklists always loaded, no conditionals. All eight criteria paths in manifest loaded fully by parent. All known detection rules read; other profiles do not match. Knowledge searches returned empty KB. PAL unavailable (no PAL/listmodels/codereview tool exposed).
Rejected approaches: None supplied.
'''
context_path = bundle / 'context.md'
context_path.write_text(context)
manifest['context'] = str(context_path)
manifest_path = bundle / 'manifest.json'
manifest_path.write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + '\\n')
for path in bundle.rglob('*'):
    if path.is_file(): path.chmod(0o444)
print(json.dumps({'bundle': str(bundle), 'manifest': str(manifest_path), 'criteria_count': len(manifest['instructions'])}, indent=2))
print(data.decode())
